$comment: Optional art for built modules. Paths are relative to the project root (or absolute). null = build without it; missing images are hidden at runtime. A configured path that does not exist fails the build. IRIDESCENTLY_SLAY_IMAGES_DIR overrides slay.images for one build.

layout.cards/<icon>.svg: card faces; icon names from ELEMENT_ICONS / CARD_ICONS in server/app/src/slay-the-web/public/ui/cards.js (metal, wood, water, fire, earth, spirit, space, mind, artifact, lock, common, sword, black-cat, ...)
layout.cursors/: default.png, point.png, select.png, grab-open.png (CSS falls back to the system cursor)
layout.scenes/: backgrounds referenced from public/ui/styles/app.css and lingzhi-xiuxing.js
layout.*.png: small icons: block, damage, vulnerable, potion-green, potion-red, exclamation, spoder
